references.role: primary art style, material texture and architectural detail scale

prompt: Use case: style-transfer and architectural repaint. Create ONE production original fantasy strategy map town sprite on TRUE transparent RGBA, square 1024x1024. Two input reference images: IMAGE 1 HIGHWATER KEEP is the PRIMARY ART STYLE AND DETAIL SCALE reference: match its finely textured, restrained, weathered, late-1990s hand-painted/pre-rendered adventure-map raster appearance, tiny buildings, realistic stone courses, crisp granular detail, restrained speculars and densely layered settlement depth. IMAGE 2 OLD RIVERWATCH is the ARCHITECTURAL IDENTITY reference only: grey fortress, burnt-red roofs, fortified front gateway, small bronze cannon details and one fire-beacon tower. Repaint Riverwatch to belong convincingly in the SAME GAME AS IMAGE 1. This is a sprawling compact fortified settlement, not a clean symmetrical castle icon. Dense varied small roof volumes, tight cobbled courtyards, stairs, timber galleries, low workshops, guardhouses and unequal rear towers packed inside connected stone curtain walls. Architecturally plausible narrow windows, many small irregular stone blocks and small crenellations. Make the interior architecture ASYMMETRIC: an off-centre beacon tower toward the back, a larger pitched-roof hall on one side, several stepped smaller roof groups on the other, unequal auxiliary towers. Keep the rear skyline organic, not mirrored. Dominant overall mass is broad and low, painted width about 1.2 to 1.35 times total painted height; the beacon is slender and moderately tall rather than a huge central trophy. Muted rusty terracotta roofs, aged cool grey/earth-grey stone with grime in recesses, dark weathered timber, small old-bronze accents, modest warm windows and one small orange beacon fire. No oversaturated candy red, smooth glossy gold, thick cartoon edges, giant masonry blocks, exaggerated gate, huge cannon barrels, toy castle proportions, mobile-game icon shading, blown highlights or smooth CGI. Maintain material readability and natural midtone contrast; do not merely darken everything. CAMERA/ORIENTATION: elevated orthographic view looking DOWN about 45-50 degrees, enough to see courtyard floors and roof planes like Image 1, but the FRONT GATE and FRONT WALL FACE STRAIGHT TOWARD THE VIEWER/SOUTH, centered at the bottom; no diagonal corner-first rotated front wall. Front wall runs horizontally, left and right wings recede into the image, architectural interior need not be symmetrical. Small normal-sized arched entrance at exact front-centre with stone threshold meeting the lowest centre of the foundation so game flags can flank it. Upper-left soft daylight, restrained short contact shadows. No baked FLAG, BANNER, PENNANT, STANDARD, TAPESTRY, CLOTH, FLAGPOLE or HERALDIC BADGE anywhere: remove those from Image 2; ownership flags are rendered separately by the game. Isolate the entire settlement on actual alpha transparency, neutral masonry foundations only; no landscape island, green grass, outer river/waterfall, moat, lava, big ground shadow, background or platform. No text, grid, interface or watermark. Keep complete silhouette including flame and footing inside about 7% transparent margins. Output a detailed authentic map sprite, not an illustrated card.
purpose: Owner-requested style correction: detailed weathered settlement matching established towns, centered south-facing gate, elevated view, asymmetric interior, no baked flags or banners.
packing: tools/pack_riverwatch_front.py: mechanical alpha crop and aspect-preserving downsample to 480px maximum painted extent inside a transparent 512px canvas.
